entries.name: Basic AI Generation
entries.description: Integrate AI text and content generation directly into the editor.

entries.name: Client AI Toolkit
entries.description: Give AI agents tools that read and edit the document directly in the browser.

entries.name: Server AI Toolkit
entries.description: Flexible primitives and tools for AI agents to read, edit, and manipulate documents.

entries.name: Comments
entries.description: Enable discussions in your collaborative documents—the way you want them.

entries.name: Tracked Changes
entries.description: Enable suggestion mode for collaborative editing and document review workflows.

entries.name: Compare
entries.description: Find and show the changes between two documents or two versions.

entries.name: Compare snapshots
entries.description: Compare snapshots of your documents to see changes made between two versions.

entries.name: DOC export
entries.description: Export editor content as a legacy Word document (DOC).

entries.name: DOCX export
entries.description: Export editor content as a Word document (DOCX).

entries.name: DOCX import
entries.description: Import Word documents (DOCX) into the editor.

entries.name: EPUB export
entries.description: Export editor content as an e-book (EPUB).

entries.name: Markdown export
entries.description: Export editor content as Markdown.

entries.name: ODT export
entries.description: Export editor content as an OpenDocument text file (ODT).

entries.name: PDF export
entries.description: Export editor content as a PDF.

entries.name: Content Protection
entries.description: Control which parts of a Tiptap document users can edit or read.

entries.name: Slots
entries.description: Build editable document templates with embedded, validated Slot fields.

entries.name: Variables
entries.description: Display reactive values in your editor and synchronize editable slots.

entries.name: Diagrams
entries.description: Charts and flow diagrams in the document, drawn by a Renderer of your choice.

entries.name: Pages
entries.description: Transform your editor into a page-based document interface with margins and page breaks.

entries.name: Whiteboard
entries.description: Turn an editor into a whiteboard with sticky notes, shapes, arrows, drawings, and doc frames.

entries.name: Starter kit
entries.description: The most common extensions in one: text formatting, headings, lists, code, links, and undo and redo.

entries.name: Bold
entries.description: Make text bold.

entries.name: Code
entries.description: Mark inline code, such as a function name, inside a sentence.

entries.name: Highlight
entries.description: Highlight text with a background color.

entries.name: Italic
entries.description: Make text italic for emphasis.

entries.name: Link
entries.description: Link text to a URL, with optional autolinking of typed URLs.

entries.name: Ruby text
entries.description: Add reading guides, including furigana, with HTML ruby annotations.

entries.name: Strike
entries.description: Strike through text.

entries.name: Subscript
entries.description: Write text slightly below the normal line, as in H2O.

entries.name: Superscript
entries.description: Write text slightly above the normal line, as in exponents or footnote markers.

entries.name: Underline
entries.description: Underline text.

entries.name: TextStyle kit
entries.description: The text styling extensions in one: text style, color, background color, font family, font size, and line height.

entries.name: Background color
entries.description: Set the background color of text.

entries.name: Color
entries.description: Set the color of text.

entries.name: Font family
entries.description: Set the font family of text.

entries.name: Font size
entries.description: Set the font size in the editor.

entries.name: Line height
entries.description: Add text line-height support to your editor.

entries.name: Text align
entries.description: Align text left, right, centered, or justified.

entries.name: Text style
entries.description: Adds the span element that color, font, and size extensions build on.

entries.name: Blockquote
entries.description: Set off a quote as its own block.

entries.name: Details
entries.description: Add collapsible details nodes to your editor content.

entries.name: Details content
entries.description: Add content to your details nodes.

entries.name: Details summary
entries.description: Add a summary to your details nodes.

entries.name: Document
entries.description: The top node of every document; required.

entries.name: Hard break
entries.description: Break a line inside a paragraph without starting a new one.

entries.name: Heading
entries.description: Headings from level 1 to 6.

entries.name: Horizontal rule
entries.description: A horizontal line that separates sections.

entries.name: Paragraph
entries.description: The basic block for text; required in most editors.

entries.name: Text
entries.description: The text content of a document; required.

entries.name: List kit
entries.description: The list extensions in one: bullet and ordered lists, list items, task lists, and list keymap.

entries.name: Bullet list
entries.description: Unordered lists with bullet points.

entries.name: List item
entries.description: The item of a bullet or ordered list.

entries.name: List keymap
entries.description: Keyboard behavior for lists, such as joining and lifting list items.

entries.name: Ordered list
entries.description: Numbered lists.

entries.name: Task item
entries.description: The item of a task list, with a checkbox.

entries.name: Task list
entries.description: Lists of tasks that users check off.

entries.name: Table kit
entries.description: The table extensions in one: table, row, header, and cell.

entries.name: Table
entries.description: Tables with resizable columns, merged cells, and header rows.

entries.name: Table cell
entries.description: The cell of a table row.

entries.name: Table header
entries.description: A header cell of a table.

entries.name: Table row
entries.description: The row of a table.

entries.name: Code block
entries.description: Blocks of code on several lines.

entries.name: Code block lowlight
entries.description: Code blocks with syntax highlighting, using lowlight.

entries.name: Mathematics
entries.description: Write and render math formulas with LaTeX.

entries.name: Audio
entries.description: Embed audio files directly into your documents.

entries.name: Image
entries.description: Insert images into the document.

entries.name: Twitch
entries.description: Embed Twitch videos, clips, and channels.

entries.name: YouTube
entries.description: Embed YouTube videos.

entries.name: Emoji
entries.description: Render emojis as inline nodes with fallback images for unsupported emojis.

entries.name: Mention
entries.description: Mention other users with a suggestion popup and full control over the rendering.

entries.name: Bubble menu
entries.description: A menu that appears next to the selected text, for example to format it.

entries.name: Drag handle
entries.description: A handle to drag blocks to another place in the document.

entries.name: Drag handle React
entries.description: The drag handle as a React component.

entries.name: Drag handle Vue
entries.description: The drag handle as a Vue component.

entries.name: Floating menu
entries.description: A menu that appears on empty lines, for example to insert blocks.

entries.name: Dropcursor
entries.description: Shows where dragged content will be dropped.

entries.name: Focus
entries.description: Adds a class to the node that has the cursor.

entries.name: Gapcursor
entries.description: Lets the cursor sit in places where no text can go, such as next to a table.

entries.name: Selection
entries.description: Preserve the selection when the editor is blurred.

entries.name: Character count
entries.description: Count characters and words, and limit their number.

entries.name: Find and replace
entries.description: Search, highlight, navigate, and replace text in your editor.

entries.name: Invisible characters
entries.description: Show spaces, line breaks, and paragraph ends.

entries.name: Placeholder
entries.description: Show a placeholder text in empty documents or nodes.

entries.name: Typography
entries.description: Replace plain characters with typographic ones, such as curly quotes and dashes, as you type.

entries.name: Undo and redo
entries.description: Undo and redo changes in the editor.

entries.name: Table of contents
entries.description: Add a table of contents listing all your anchors or headlines.

entries.name: Trailing node
entries.description: Adds a node after the last block node in the editor.

entries.name: Unique ID
entries.description: Give every node a unique ID.

entries.name: File handler
entries.description: Handle files that users drop or paste into the editor.

entries.name: Paste handler
entries.description: Automatically clean and normalize pasted content from external sources like Microsoft Excel, Word, and Google Docs.

entries.name: Collaboration
entries.description: Edit a document together in real time.

entries.name: Collaboration caret
entries.description: Show the cursors and names of other people editing.

entries.name: Snapshots
entries.description: Document version history for manual and automatic versioning of your documents.
